content_of_post_to_comment: “I hate math!” Lots of students say this, but, in my experience, very few of them actually hate math. They hate feeling stupid. If a teacher can transform math class from a place where students feel stupid into a place where students feel smart, suddenly they are able to tolerate math. Sometimes, they even love it.
comment: The interesting challenge is that making students feel smart can't mean removing struggle. The best math classrooms may be those where confusion becomes evidence of learning rather than evidence of inability.
